name: CDDM
description: CDDM (Crop Disease Domain Multimodal) is a large-scale multimodal benchmark dataset for crop disease diagnosis, containing 137,000 images and 1 million question-answer pairs. It supports development of vision-language models for agricultural applications, enabling precise and useful advice for disease identification and management.
reputation: A large-scale multimodal crop disease benchmark that has gained attention in agricultural vision-language research, though it is still relatively new.
notes: Includes a novel finetuning strategy using LoRA; dataset publicly available at provided GitHub link.
